description:
Title: LAN Party

You are planning a LAN party for 10 friends, so the first thing you have to do is to send invitations to these 10 friends.
Next, you have to find out which games they want to play.
As soon as you have received a list of games, you can appoint a date when the LAN party is going to happen.
If 8 or more people agree on this date, you are good to continue.
Else, you have to appoint another date, until 8 people are free to join you.
While you find a date, you can find out if you have all the games your guests want to play.
If some are missing, download them.
Next, you should find out how much beer your friends will require.
If you do not have enough, buy what's missing.
After that, you can enjoy the LAN party.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitations" name="Invitations"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GameList" name="List of games they want to play"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateProposal" name="Date proposal"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateResponses" name="Date responses"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_LANParty">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Organizer" name="Organizer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Plan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvitations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ReceiveGameList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AppointDate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendDateProposal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ReceiveDateResponses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DateDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRequestedGames</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GamesAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DownloadMissingGames</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GamesMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FindRequiredBeer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BeerDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyMissingBeer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BeerMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnjoyParty</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Party</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Plan LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive the list of games they want to play">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_GameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Find a date and check for the requested games"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDateProposal" name="Send the date to the friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveDateResponses" name="Receive responses about who is free to join">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DateResponses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateDecision" name="Do 8 or more people agree on this date?" default="Flow_DateRetry"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequestedGames" name="Find out if all requested games are available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesAvailable" name="Are all the games available?" default="Flow_GamesMissing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadMissingGames" name="Download missing games"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Continue after checking games"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date and games are ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindRequiredBeer" name="Find out how much beer the friends require"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerDecision" name="Is there enough beer?" default="Flow_BeerMissing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyMissingBeer" name="Buy the missing beer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue after checking beer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Party" name="LAN party enjoyed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Invitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_Plan" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_GameList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Event_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameList_Split" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Date" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Date_SendProposal" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_SendDateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendProposal_Responses" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDateResponses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Responses_DateDecision" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveDateResponses" targetRef="Gateway_DateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateAccepted" name="8 or more people agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">attendingCount >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateRetry" name="Fewer than 8 people agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRequestedGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGames_Availability" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequestedGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable" name="All games are available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allRequestedGamesAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing" name="Some games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Task_DownloadMissingGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Download_GamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadMissingGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_Beer" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_FindRequiredBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Beer_Decision" sourceRef="Task_FindRequiredBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">availableBeer >= requiredBeer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMissing" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Task_BuyMissingBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyMissingBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enjoy_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_Party"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organizer" name="Organizer" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitations" name="Invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Invitations"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="List of games they want to play" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_ReceiveGameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateProposal" name="Date proposal" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_DateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateResponses" name="Date responses" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDateResponses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
